user.title: Choose how Sonance EQ connects
user.description: Routing-only works with any Home Assistant media player. Music Assistant adds stream DSP. PowerZone controls Sonance amplifier output EQ directly.

music_assistant.title: Connect Music Assistant DSP
music_assistant.description: Use a local Music Assistant URL and an access token with player DSP read/write permission.

powerzone.title: Connect Sonance PowerZone
powerzone.description: Use the amplifier's private LAN hostname or IP. The official control API is unauthenticated, so never expose port 7621 or /ws to the internet.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add discovered Sonance PowerZone
zeroconf_confirm.description: Connect to {name} at {host}. Only continue if this amplifier is on a trusted private network; its official control protocol has no authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Music Assistant
error.cannot_connect_powerzone: Could not verify a local PowerZone output-EQ API at this address
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or lacks DSP permissions
error.unsupported_version: Music Assistant 2.10.1 or newer is required for Sonance DSP presets

abort.already_configured: This Sonance EQ connection is already configured
abort.cannot_connect_powerzone: The discovered device did not expose the required local PowerZone EQ API
